{
    "content": "<p>Published my first Google Chrome extension today, Print Helper for Google\nCalendar.</p>\n<!--more-->\n<p>It allows people to print multiple weeks or months of their Google Calendar(s)\nat a time. This is something that Google doesn't show in the print UI - but is\navailable if you tweak the URL that is sent to generate the printable pages. I'm\nnot sure why Google doesn't expose the date selection themselves, as it's a very\nneeded feature for those using Google Apps day to day.</p>\n<p>Enjoy!</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Update 1/18/2011:</strong> Released v1.1, which now allows more urls\nwhen determining when to activate the icon. This should resolve the reported\nissue. Found that the icon was now appearing on the print preview window, so\nreleased v1.2 which keeps the icon from appearing there.</li>\n<li>**Update 2/11/2011:**Released v1.21, which just added the ™ to\nabide by Google's branding rules for extensions. Released v1.30 - allowing\ngenerated calendars to be in other languages, show/hide weekends, and set week\nstart day.</li>\n<li>**Update ????**The plugin is no longer in the store, as Google\nadded the cabability to their own calendar UI.</li>\n</ul>\n",
